finding: The official Abiertos roster currently enumerates five treatment-study pages. The pages were individually opened. Four were originally published in 2013 and one in 2014; three retain 2014–2017 modification dates and two share the same 2026-11-02 modification timestamp. AB07008 is independently documented as a 2015 confirmatory study. The live category label alone does not establish current recruitment or a current cutoff for any protocol, so no catalog trial was added.
